thread:
Alex (eng-release): Heads-up: we're starting preflight checks for the 0.9.2 rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT. Short freeze from 09:30-11:30 for critical paths. Please read below for canary exceptions.
Maria (release-manager): FYI: this one includes the KV-cache change and a quant plugin update; both have perf impact risk on small batches.
Sanjay (platform): Do we have SLA relax window? Can we raise latency SLO for canaries to 600ms? Current is 300ms.
Maria (release-manager): Yes — for canary only we'll relax target to 600ms. Production SLO unchanged. This is for 2 canary waves only.
Jess (oncall): Will this require traffic shaping? I can update the routing policy if needed.
Kevin (infra): We'll carve out a canary lane in r1 pool, capacity reduced to preserve prod headroom. Nothing manual required from apps.
Maria (release-manager): Exemptions: if you need to land a change in the freeze window (09:30-11:30 PT) file a short justification here and ping me. Exemptions are limited to bugfixes with regression risk.
Alex (eng-release): Example exemption wording: "hotfix: embeddings mismatch causing 5% error spike; revert candidate queued" — include rollbacks and target PR.
QA-runner: Test checklist posted -> https://internal/redwood/tests/preflight-0.9.2 (run smoke + long tail). Please attach run id if you see regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 scheduled: 2025-06-15T10:00:00Z -> targets: 3% traffic, 10m ramp, SLA relaxed to 600ms for canary.
Jess (oncall): I'll monitor error budget and open incident channel if errors > 2% for 5min. @Maria if we hit, will we auto-fallback?
Maria (release-manager): Yes, rollout policy: auto-fallback to previous model variant at 2% errors sustained 5m OR latency > 2x baseline. Ops will be notified.
Sanjay (platform): One ask: any teams doing long-running streams? Those could be impacted by KV-cache changes. Please flag here.
Alex (eng-release): If you need an exemption add a single-line justification + PR link. I'll consolidate and send to exec oncall for approval.
Kevin (infra): Also note: autoscaling knobs adjusted to be more conservative during rollout. I'll post the infra command if you need to replicate:
Kevin (infra): ```
# rollback helper
redwoodctl rollout cancel --canary-id $CANARY
``` 
Maria (release-manager): Thanks all. Final preflight checklist at 08:00 PT tomorrow in this thread. :white_check_mark:
Jess (oncall): ack :thumbsup:
Alex (eng-release): pinging product leads for visibility: @product-leads
